title: GitHub Copilot app: The agent-native desktop experience
attributed_claim_summary: GitHub announced a technical-preview interface for managing multiple agent tasks with work visibility and isolation.
evidence_or_event: Claims are attributed to the original publisher; no original study results produced here.
limitations: Vendor announcement; claimed benefits and pain points are not independently causal estimates.
research_relevance: AI-era coding methods, independently accepted functionality, OSS reuse and lifecycle cost
practical_experiment: Use one task evidence log per agent run and measure review queueing, duplicate work, and human attention.
